content_blocks.expected_output: Calculates a date/time result using serial values; the exact interpretation depends on cell values, formatting, locale and whether holidays or overnight intervals matter.
content_blocks.run_instructions: Enter real Excel date/time values, not ambiguous text. Apply an appropriate number format and test boundaries such as month-end, blanks and overnight durations.
content_blocks.reset_steps: Work in a duplicate workbook or a scratch sheet. Restore the input range and formula/code to the original state, clear filters or selections, then rerun the same test cases. Record expected and actual behavior rather than assuming a successful result.
